description: An apsidal building identified by cropmarks in 2006, originally thought to be a Norman church. It was excavated in 2013, it was discovered to be Roman in date, but largely robbed out. Excavators suggested it was a temple, possibly a Mithraeum, this appears mainly to be based on the apsidal form of the structure. In 2018-2019 a 3rd CE coin hoard was discovered by metal detectorists near to the structure.
